topography.project_purpose: Anzen Finance is the issuer of USDz, an omnichain real-world-asset-backed digital dollar, with associated staking/rewards and LayerZero-based cross-chain bridging. sUSDz and governance-related mechanics should be treated as associated protocol components only where verified by Anzen documentation or audits.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Mainnet family serves as the hub with SPCTPool, USDz, and sUSDz, while L2 families (Arbitrum, Base, Blast, Manta) use Vaults and Child tokens to extend stablecoin functionality cross-chain via LayerZero adapters. Governance and staking are unified through AnzenToken and Treasury multisigs.
